$comment: Single source of truth for per-route SEO. Consumed by src/content/seo.ts (page metadata, sitemap, robots) and by scripts/generate-og.mjs (OG card rendering). Plain JSON so the .mjs build script and the TypeScript app can share it without duplication. Card blurbs (og.blurb) intentionally carry no trailing period; other terminal punctuation such as ! is fine. The / entry's description is the site description: it feeds both the homepage meta description tag and the Person JSON-LD description, so there is only one string to keep current.

routes.$titleComment: A label only. Home's title is the bare site title from site.ts, so nothing reads this field; every other route composes "<title lowercased> | john mo's site".
